RNA_mix_partition_cavity_v1.target: Explain emergence and persistence of B cavity q(t), derive a discriminating prediction versus carryover-driven global phase change.
known_relations: A/B q(t) diverge after similar initial values (initial_measurements.json).
Purified length fractions have different endpoint q summaries (fraction_dev.json), single preparation, unequal fields.
C04 has different measured species concentrations across dilute/dense tie-lines; zero/zero variant ratio is undefined.
DNA read fraction does not establish RNA abundance, transcription, or active valence.
hypotheses: NEW provisional hypothesis: if transcription produces a changing reference/variant RNA mixture, composition-dependent selective partitioning may shift the local mixture into a two-phase instability. An internal dilute domain nucleates after a composition threshold; interfacial cost and slow exchange permit persistence. Proposed bridge, not observed mechanism.

gaps.description: No matched time series links RNA species proportions and phase composition to cavity nucleation/persistence; C04 endpoints cannot map to q(t).

variables_units.q: per-object cavity area / filled droplet area, dimensionless [0,1]
variables_units.x: variant RNA fraction among total RNA, dimensionless [0,1], unmeasured
variables_units.C_dense: species concentration in dense phase, ng/uL
variables_units.C_dilute: species concentration in dilute phase, ng/uL

equations: Phenomenological, unclosed: dq/dt = kf*max(x-xc,0)*(qmax-q)-kc*q, 0<=q<=qmax<=1. It encodes a threshold/persistence hypothesis; it does not derive x(t) or thermodynamics.
At a tie-line Ki=Ci,dense/Ci,dilute when denominator is positive; C04 propagated ranges are not confidence intervals. No relation maps Ki or concentration to q.

parameters_ranges.kf_kc: positive h^-1, unmeasured; no numeric range justified

RNA_mix_partition_cavity_v1.initial_boundary_conditions: q(0) observed near .014 in A and B; x(0), phase geometry, interface conditions unknown. No spatial boundary conditions: not a closed spatial model.
RNA_mix_partition_cavity_v1.observation_mapping: Compare q(t) only with supplied per-object mean_empty_area_fraction under same segmentation. It is not concentration, volume fraction, or total-area ratio. x and phase concentrations are unmeasured in time course.
alternatives: Carryover changes transcription/solution conditions and shifts phase state without causal RNA mixture effect.
Population turnover, sampling, or segmentation alters mean q while individual cavity state is stable; C03 lacks longitudinal cavity state/area.
predictions: At matched total RNA and carryover, varying measured RNA mixture fraction shifts onset or endpoint q; threshold-like response. E02 is suggestive but does not establish a mixing-ratio response.

At fixed composition and matched solution conditions, pure carryover predicts matching/removing carryover explains A/B without residual x dependence; mixture hypothesis predicts residual composition dependence.
If B q rises while x and phase partitioning remain constant, the proposed accumulating-composition bridge weakens.
checks: Do not infer RNA fractions from DNA frequencies.
Equation has q/h units on both sides and is bounded for q in [0,qmax] with nonnegative rates.
For x<=xc, dq/dt=-kc*q; kf=0 gives no formation; q=qmax removes formation. Algebraic checks only, not executed computation.
C04 tie-line 0 variant partition undefined because both concentrations are zero.
E02 fields/objects are not independent preparation replicates.
evidence_conflicts: E02 endpoints are compatible with mixture effect, but no precise RNA proportions or time series.
C04 ratios vary across tie-lines and have broad nonstatistical ranges; not evidence of cavity causation.
A/B differ in more than template sequence; carryover remains live.
untested: Whether variant DNA is transcribed into stable RNA, abundance over time, or functional valence.
Whether cavities are a distinct phase; 3D geometry, interfacial tension, exchange kinetics.
Whether matched-total-RNA/carryover controls preserve mixture effect.
No new experiment or computation performed.

reply.recognition: uncertain; no specific study recognized with confidence
reply.summary: Target q is mean per-object cavity area fraction, not RNA concentration or area-weighted total. A/B diverge after similar t=0 (24 h A .00446, B .08918). C02 descriptive B fit predicts .121 at 36 h and .156 at 48 h, but near-unit plateau and linear alternative show extrapolation sensitivity; no preparation-level interval. C01: reference DNA 94.66%, listed variants 5.00% (sum 99.66%); repeat-rich alignments are nonunique and do not identify active RNA valence. E02 purified length fractions M/M+L/M+S have near-zero/increased endpoint q, with one preparation and unequal fields. E04/C04 phase partition endpoints vary, but no phase volumes, B RNA composition time-course, or cavity mapping. C03 lacks persistent same-droplet cavity state/area trajectories. Missing relation: evolving mixture and partitioning to cavity formation/persistence.
